lanes.handoff: The third redesign batch (three-channel shell, #300): the reviewed redesign branches merged into one PR to main in the order their PRs give, the coordinator's decision of 2026-10-24. This lane exists only while the batch is assembled: its merges and the regenerated clients are filed under it, and the batch's last commit releases it with the lanes whose work the batch completes.

The new shell's finish (10-24): Critique Table layers by tone instead of outlines and sets dark type a weight lighter; counts in tabular figures; a reply being written washes in; panels rise, answers spring, Ctrl K fades open. For the third batch after the relay (10-26 07:30); not merged before. Waiting by length (ADR-011 §8): no mark under 1 s, a measured bar and time left past 10 s, reading states apart from empty.

Fewer broken skills reach the user (from 10_harness论文对S-1的启发.md, items 1-3): a package that cannot run is caught when it is read and named in plain words in Settings; a run that writes nothing fails and one that misses a file its manifest names says so; every failure says what to do next and an Agent's exact request is not run a third time. Merged with batch 3 after the paper relay.

第三批「出图有记录、重复出图秒出」: GET /api/runtime (and so the Hub's project snapshot) names the project's newest drawings for the attention page; a native model's verified drawing source is kept in the projection cache, so a restarted Runtime answers a registered drawing without reading the model.

A4: a person answers once per project for what Codex asks in a conversation (a command, going online, the Hub's own tools) instead of once per call, and withdraws it in Settings. Stacked on claude/300-skill-guard (batch 3): that lane's work is in this branch, so its claim is dropped here and its files are claimed again by this lane. Merged with batch 3 after the paper relay.

skill.json can name the inputs a run must be given (manifest.requiredInputs); a request that lacks one is refused before anyone is asked to allow anything, in words that name what is missing. Stacked on claude/300-skill-guard (batch 3): that lane's work is in this branch, so its claim is dropped here and its files are claimed again by this lane. Merged with batch 3 after the paper relay.
第三批「出错不用自己去点重试」(03 的 4-1、4-3): one table of failure kinds for the Hub and the Runtime; the Hub sends again what did nothing and says how many times; a failed operation's card hands it to the AI.

Fewer small things to type (05 B3, D6): AI render needs no model name (the default renders) and a pasted Gemini key is checked at once; MonkeyFab keeps the printer address that was reached. B2 (endpoint by provider) is already in main; D3 (Codex import) is not in main yet; the access code is still typed each time. Merged with batch 3.

一句话直接办 (batch 3, 10-24): a sentence that means a listed command offers it on a confirm card (one click runs it, a missing argument is asked on the card); the Hub finds commands by meaning with a local embedding model (numpy, bge-small-zh-v1.5) and the web falls back to its keyword search. Into claude/300-batch3 via the merge session; not into main before 10-26 07:30.
第三批第 13 条「读快照不报错」: a model asset's native index is decoded once (at registration, in the background, or at its first read) and kept in the projection cache by its bytes.
The Attention page's tile beside the conclusion shows the newest drawing with its first page; one click opens it on the Board, switching project first when needed (batch 3, from claude/300-batch3).
第三批第 15 条「坏了自己修好，通知一声」(03 4-2, F007): the repair table; a stopped Studio is started again by the Hub, at most three times in ten minutes, and the attention queue says so.

A document page links an uploaded file to the model being edited at once (no dropdown, no click) and says 'linked to X · change'; changing the link keeps the earlier link's record (modelSourceHistory) instead of overwriting it. The Board half (3-1) waits for 0-5b. Merged with batch 3.

Todo 14. The 13 'continue / record' decision rows of ADR-014 B4 are already the decision card (#700: nine converted; the other four go with D-3 and 4-4). What remains is the polish rule 'a wait is shown by how long it lasts': eighteen reading and loading lines in fifteen files take the class wait-late (base.css) and show after a second. Based on claude/300-batch3 (the polish rules are there). Merged with batch 3.

第三批第 8 条「圈一下说一句就改」第 1 步 (03 3-2): POST /api/markup/resolve reads marks on a drawing, a view sheet or a camera pass's ID image, and strokes on the model, into the components and elements they lie on. Item 22 C+A rides on branch claude/300-b3-snapshot-parts in this lane: a Live Rhino snapshot's objects read as building parts, kept per file, named by a mark on its drawings.

Todo 4 (05 C1, C2, D1, D5). C1: MonkeyHub opens Rhino with its script server on (POST /api/live-rhino/open; the caller asks the person first); a Rhino already open without the server still needs StartScriptServer typed once (Rhino's startup-commands setting is not written: its settings key is unconfirmed). C2: RhinoCode.exe was already found through Windows' App Paths; the message no longer leads with the environment variable. D1/D5: a folder or archive file is chosen in Windows' own dialog. D2 (workspace default) is already so; D4 (join) has no page in main. Merged with batch 3.

F046: a read that failed is tried again by itself after 1 s and 3 s; its button shows only when the failure stays; the background list says which attempt a resent request is on (batch 3, from claude/300-batch3).
F093: a page that is a horizontal cut plan MonkeyDiagram drew gets its tracing scale and direction from the drawing; measuring a line stays one click away (batch 3, from claude/300-batch3).

Todo 21. A short sentence on a mass or a sketch is something the AI reads: a mass takes it as the facet description.note (recorded from the person's own words through the facets proposal, read in the model view and by the compiler); a sketch takes it as the text typed inside the shape, which the Board view now tells as that shape's note. No interface change. Merged with batch 3.

2-5 比较并决定: a decision card's 比较并决定 opens its two results side by side (the later one against the earlier, not its original) with the card under them; answered there it closes the comparison (batch 3, from claude/300-batch3).

Todo 19. The left column shows, under each project's name, where the project stands: 'Current V16' (the project's published version, and its accepted Stage when it has one). Based on claude/300-batch3 (the attention shell is there). Merged with batch 3.
第三批第 13 条后一半「读写分开」: a camera pass is read, meshed and drawn in a drawing worker, so the project's other requests answer at once while it runs; only retaining its images stays in the Runtime.
20 前台只剩草图、体块和少量语义描述: the right rail shows only the background while it runs, the composer's target and model lines stay out of the way until used (batch 3, from claude/300-batch3).

17: without Codex installed a new conversation starts on the signed-in Claude Code and the composer says so in a sentence; the CLI's English is not shown. Stacked on front-minimal (ChatShell.tsx, attentionShell test).

Todo 19, follow-up: the line under a project name is the step its working design stands on, named as the history page names it (what the person or the AI called it, else the Stage accepted on it, else the words it was asked in), not the project's formal version. ChatProject gets a step field read from the project's own files under their stats. Based on claude/300-batch3. Merged with batch 3.
18: under the empty input, a hint and 3-4 sentences made from the project (its last two versions, what was asked there before); one click says it. Stacked on composer-words.

User recording, item 3: clicking back on the first point closes a drawn outline (the closing point is dropped before it is sent, a double click's repeated corner too; a line that came back to its start is a flat face), and a request the API cannot read is reported for the shape it came closest to, not for every shape the route takes ('Extra inputs are not permitted' was the other shapes, not a version mismatch). Based on claude/300-batch3.

20 (S01 inventory): the right column keeps only the change history; the status line's words open the background; back/forward only when there is somewhere to go; usage and the shell/style switches only in developer mode; greyed commands and a New topic that cannot start are not listed.
Every place that printed a service error now shows one plain sentence and a next step; the browser walkthrough fails on raw service text.

Tracing Paper without friction: Esc (or Ctrl+K) exits the whole paper in one press; Clear (Ctrl+Shift+X) takes every mark in one undoable step without a confirmation; leaving the paper retains it as one model-annotation revision and removes its ink from the model; the next paper starts blank and modification history can continue any retained paper; a text tool writes a short sentence, and a sentence on one resolved component is read as that component's description.note.
A skill with a program runs through the Hub in a Claude chat (SKILL.md opens with how to start it); the permission page says what it governs.
